plan.label: YouTube channel
plan.oneLiner: Agents script, package and cut videos from footage the client owns or has licensed; the owner checks every draft and publishes it.

offers.name: Episode package
offers.description: From the client's raw footage or idea: a script with scored hooks, an edit list and first cut, a title and thumbnail pair, a description with chapters, and a pinned comment.

offers.name: Shorts from your own video
offers.description: From one long video the client owns: self-contained vertical clips with captions and a title for each.

offers.name: Clips under a licence or clip programme
offers.description: Clips from another creator's show, only under a licence or the creator's clip programme recorded at intake, each crediting the source.

approvals.words: Confirm the footage is the client's own, licensed, or covered by the creator's clip programme. No rights, no order.
Approve the quote for any AI voice, presenter or generated footage before it is paid for. One approval buys one run of that exact script.
Watch the cut and read the package before it reaches the client.
You or the client publish in YouTube Studio. Chausar never says a video was posted.
